beats.say: 3 models: OpenAI just upgraded its lineup as GPT-6.1 Terra arrived on Monday 26 October.
TechCrunch says the earlier GPT-6.1 Sol model was presented at OpenAI's DevDay event to cost less.
This new version upgrades ChatGPT and Codex systems with the fresh Terra capability for everyday users around the world.
Ars Technica reports that another planned variant named Astra was cancelled due to safety and alignment concerns.
OpenAI decided the Astra build was simply too insecure to release safely to the public.
Terra is now live in your pocket, but would you trust an artificial intelligence that skipped safety checks?
